input.summary: Complete the left Duck bank (and the right Rabbit bank when required) to light the center ramp. Shoot the ramp before its value times out, then repeat the sequence.

steps.text: Complete the four left Duck targets. On copies that require both banks, also complete the right Rabbit targets.
When the center ramp lights, shoot it before the timer expires. Its sequence advances through 30,000, 50,000, 100,000, and 100,000.
Keep making the center ramp while its next value flashes. If the timer expires, the sequence steps back one level instead of resetting completely.
Repeat the target-bank and center-ramp cycle.

alternatives.title: Timed playfield multiplier and Cycle Jump
alternatives.when: Use this when the top lanes and left corkscrew are returning safely.

steps.text: Complete the 1-9-8-6 top lanes to start the timed playfield multiplier.
Shoot the right Cycle Jump ramp while the timer is running. Its top opening scores 200,000 before the playfield multiplier.

cautions.response: Favor the center ramp after it is lit; use the upper routes only when their returns are surviving.

input.simpleOverview: Comet uses its Duck and Rabbit targets to light a timed center-ramp sequence. Each ramp collect advances the next value, while a timeout drops the sequence only one level. Complete the top lanes to light the timed playfield multiplier at Cycle Jump.
input.overview: Comet lights its timed center-ramp ladder through the Duck and Rabbit banks. Keep shooting the lit ramp through its rising values. When the upper route is controlled, complete 1-9-8-6 and collect the timed playfield multiplier at the right Cycle Jump.

content.summary: Complete the target bank or banks that light the center ramp, then shoot the ramp before its next value times out.

steps.title: Light the center ramp
steps.text: Complete the four left Duck targets. If the ramp remains unlit, complete the right Rabbit targets too.

steps.title: Run the ramp sequence
steps.text: Shoot the lit center ramp before its timer expires. Keep shooting it as the value rises through 30,000, 50,000, and 100,000.
